name: cotel-dectlink-siemens
description: COTEL R.L. - Sistema de Gestión de Planta Externa Siemens DECTlink & Migraciones

scripts.dev:all: pnpm run dev & pnpm run dev:backend
scripts.build: pnpm --filter frontend build && pnpm --filter scripts run copy:dist
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter frontend lint && pnpm --filter scripts lint && pnpm --filter types lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter frontend typecheck && pnpm --filter scripts typecheck && pnpm --filter types typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter frontend test && pnpm --filter scripts test && pnpm --filter backend test
scripts.clean: pnpm --filter frontend clean && pnpm --filter scripts clean && pnpm --filter backend clean
